items.Sentence: The treatment system at the Facility consists of bar screening, an oxidation ditch, a secondary clarifier, chlorination, two continuous backwash sand filters (used alternately), final chlorine contact chamber and a 240,000 gallon concrete-lined storage pond.

Biosolids/sludge produced from the secondary clarifier is dried in eight concrete-lined sludge drying beds.
Dried sludge is hauled to a landfill for disposal.
